title: MRI, right knee
synopsis: MRI confirmed a complete tear of the ACL and a small tear of the inner (medial) meniscus. The other ligaments and cartilage looked healthy, which makes surgical repair more straightforward.

findings.text: PCL, MCL, LCL and cartilage intact

report:
**EXAM:** MRI right knee without contrast.

**FINDINGS:**

- *ACL:* Complete disruption of the mid-substance fibers with abnormal horizontal orientation. Associated bone marrow edema in the lateral femoral condyle and posterolateral tibial plateau (classic pivot-shift pattern).
- *Menisci:* Vertical longitudinal tear of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, 8 mm. Lateral meniscus intact.
- *PCL, MCL, LCL:* Intact.
- *Cartilage:* Preserved. No full-thickness defects.
- *Joint:* Moderate effusion.

**IMPRESSION:**

1. Complete ACL tear with typical bone contusion pattern.
2. Posterior horn medial meniscus tear.
3. Moderate joint effusion.
